title: SubQ: first sub-quadratic frontier LLM with 12M-token context
summary: Subquadratic, a Miami-based startup, launches SubQ, a frontier model built on a fully sub-quadratic sparse attention architecture supporting a 12 million-token context window. The company claims up to 52x speedup over FlashAttention at 1M tokens and roughly a fifth of the cost of Claude Opus or GPT-5.5 for comparable workloads.

research.notes: Launched 5 May 2026 with a $29M seed round. Claims benchmark scores of 95.0 on RULER-128K, 65.9 on MRCR v2 at 1M tokens, 81.8 on SWE-Bench Verified. Independent verification has been requested by researchers.

web_findings.title: The context window has been shattered: Subquadratic debuts a 12-million-token window
web_findings.snippet: SubQ ships with a 12 million token context window, runs roughly 52x faster than FlashAttention at 1M tokens.
